WITH state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_county_province, 
    SUM(ft.transaction_amount) as state_total
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE ft.transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(state_total) as total FROM state_totals
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.state_county_province,
    st.state_total,
    st.state_total / gt.total as share
  FROM state_totals st
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as average_share FROM shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    s.state_total,
    s.share,
    (s.share - ashr.average_share) as excess
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share ashr
  WHERE s.share > ashr.average_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(state_total) as combined_transaction_total,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM above_avg
